_comment: steps[]     one entry per state, in order. The first is the intact model and
must have "ablate": null. Each later entry names the head it
removes and the distribution that results.
p           one probability per entry in "classes", same order; should sum to 1.
totalHeads  the real head count of the model being depicted; the counter reads
"n / totalHeads". Defaults to the number actually drawn.
image       { "src": "assets/cat.jpg" } swaps in a real photo. Leave src null
to keep the built-in vector cat.
prompt      any number of short lines; the type auto-shrinks and re-wraps to fit.
timing      pulseDur is how long the sweep from the input to the end of the
stream takes. barAt must be >= pulseAt + pulseDur or the bars move
before the signal lands; step must be >= barAt + barDur.
Anything omitted here falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG in attention-ablation.js.

steps.note: a redundant head goes — the prediction barely moves
confidence erodes, but the answer survives
a head the prediction depended on — the answer collapses
the object representation is falling apart
